name: Gi-Specific Strategy
description: The Roger Gracie Closed Guard System covers guard maintenance, collar and lapel attacks, arm attacks and sweeps in the gi.
summary: Closed-guard control, submissions and routes to top position from Roger Gracie.
overview:
The Roger Gracie Closed Guard System is a focused gi course on maintaining closed guard and building offense from it. Roger covers collar and lapel chokes, arm locks, kimura and wrist-lock attacks, alongside a dedicated sweep section.

The sweep material includes scissor and hook sweeps, attacks against an opponent with both knees down and omoplata sweeps. This is a choice for someone who wants more from closed guard; it does not attempt to cover every gi guard or the whole standing and passing game.

fits: You use closed guard in the gi and want both submission attacks and ways to come on top.

includes: Lapel arm locks, kimura and wrist-lock material.

limits: The course centers on closed guard; open-guard systems, takedowns and guard passing are outside its main scope.

flashcards.question: Under IBJJF rules, may you grip an opponent’s sleeve or pant-leg opening with your fingers inside it?
flashcards.answer: No. Article 6.2.2(H) classifies that grip as a serious foul, including during a sweep or other maneuver.
